item.title: EMW WCS-X Synthesizer Update: Transient Sample Player
item.description: video upload by EMW Synthesizers "This video showcases the new transient sample player added to the WCS-X. The transient module can replace Oscillator 3, allowing you to choose between three oscillators or two oscillators plus transients. With a library of 64 transient samples, it adds a new layer of attack, punch, and character to the sound. Thanks for watching!"

item.title: Noodling with reSEMble
item.description: video upload by Randy Piscione "PM Foundations recently re-stocked a limited number of reSEMble PCB/Panel sets, and this may very well be the last time. If you’re unfamiliar with reSEMble, it is a tribute to the Oberheim SEM, but more of an SEM 2.0. Have a look at the other relevant videos on my channel for more sounds and info. If you want to build a reSEMble, go here: https://www.tindie.com
